# cpanel_ssl_installed_hosts (Data Source)

Reads the complete installed SSL virtual-host metadata inventory without exposing certificate PEM, document roots, IP addresses, or private-key material.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cpanel_ssl_installed_hosts" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `hosts` (Attributes List) The installed SSL hosts sorted by server name, certificate identifier, and FQDNs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--hosts))

<a id="nestedatt--hosts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `hosts`

Read-Only:

- `certificate` (Attributes) Safe public metadata for the installed certificate. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--hosts--certificate))
- `domains` (List of String) The host domains in sorted order, or `null` when cPanel's dedicated-IP endpoint does not report them.
- `fqdns` (List of String) The host FQDNs in sorted order, or `null` when cPanel's dedicated-IP endpoint does not report them.
- `is_primary_on_ip` (Boolean) Whether cPanel marks the host as primary on its IP, or `null` when the selected endpoint does not report the flag.
- `mail_sni_status` (Boolean) Whether cPanel reports mail SNI as enabled, or `null` when the selected endpoint does not report the flag.
- `needs_sni` (Boolean) Whether the host requires SNI, or `null` when the selected endpoint does not report the flag.
- `servername` (String) The installed virtual-host server name.

<a id="nestedatt--hosts--certificate"></a>
### Nested Schema for `hosts.certificate`

Read-Only:

- `auto_ssl_provider` (String) The AutoSSL provider identifier, when reported.
- `auto_ssl_provider_display_name` (String) The AutoSSL provider display name, when reported.
- `domains` (List of String) The certificate domains in sorted order.
- `id` (String) The installed certificate identifier.
- `is_autossl` (Boolean) Whether cPanel identifies this as an AutoSSL certificate, or `null` when the dedicated-IP endpoint does not report the flag.
- `is_self_signed` (Boolean) Whether cPanel reports the certificate as self-signed.
- `issuer_common_name` (String) The issuer common name, when reported.
- `modulus_length` (Number) The RSA modulus length, or `null` when not applicable.
- `not_after` (Number) The validity end as a Unix timestamp.
- `not_before` (Number) The validity start as a Unix timestamp.
- `signature_algorithm` (String) The signature algorithm, when reported.
- `subject_common_name` (String) The subject common name, when reported.
- `validation_type` (String) The validation type, when reported.
